name: io.github.WYRE-AI/uisp-mcp
title: UISP
description: MCP server for Ubiquiti UISP's REST API - network/ISP infrastructure monitoring for MSPs.

environmentVariables.name: UISP_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: UISP account token, generated in the UISP console under Settings > Users > API tokens.

environmentVariables.name: UISP_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the UISP instance this connector talks to, e.g. https://uisp.example.com. UISP has no shared multi-tenant endpoint; every deployment runs at its own instance FQDN.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: Transport mode for the server. Set to 'stdio' for local CLI use; the image defaults to 'http' for gateway hosting.

environmentVariables.name: AUTH_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Credential source: 'env' reads vars locally, 'gateway' expects header injection from the WYRE MCP Gateway.

environmentVariables.name: LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Log verbosity: debug, info, warn, error
